• LEMON FLAVORED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored lemon frosting; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

  • A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

  • GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

  • CONTAINS: One 16 oz tub of Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Artificially Flavored Lemon Frosting
features: A vibrant, gluten‑free lemon frosting that's rich, creamy, and bursting with zesty lemon flavor—perfectly suited for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, or even drizzling over muffins. Ready to use straight from the can, it saves time and effort with no mixing or fuss—just stir, spread, and serve. Ideal as a pantry staple, it’s great for spontaneous baking or special occasions. Crafted by trusted baking experts at Betty Crocker, it delivers consistently delicious results in every bite.
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Citric Acid, Yellow 5 Lake. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate and BHA.
